item.title: Uranium mining would create long‑term costs and risks Nova Scotia has not yet confronted - Halifax Examiner
item.description: Even with modern extraction techniques, the health risks associated with uranium and its decay products—particularly radon gas—are well established. These risks translate directly into long‑term financial and operational pressures on the agencies responsible for worker safety and compensation.
